# Lyric text in the sky, the top bar and on the Record card, fix/text120 (1280x720, GUI scale 2 as the test world starts).
# Three made-up test lines, one every 6 s: an Arabic line (0-6 s), an English line with an emoji's colour selector
# (VS16) after the sparkles and the heart (6-12 s), and a long Arabic line (12-18 s). The bar shows the line being sung
# and the card in the bottom right its lyric strip. Each shot, the branch against origin/fix/bar119:
# 1. text120-lines-arabic (Lines, the Arabic line sung, the heart line dim under it): with the old code the Arabic line
#    breaks into two short rows (cut after the fifth word); on the branch it is one row (about 210 units), centred.
#    text120-lines-heart (the heart line sung): with the old code a dashed box with "VS16" in it follows the sparkles
#    and the heart in the sky, in the top bar and on the card; on the branch no boxes. The dim Arabic lines above
#    and below it: one row and two rows on the branch, two and three with the old code.
#    text120-lines-long (the long Arabic line sung): with the old code three short rows (about 155, 140 and 125 units);
#    on the branch two fuller rows (about 430 units between them), the same words in the same order.
# 2. text120-arc-arabic: the Arc layout's Arabic line, words joined and centred: the same on both (Arc and World
#    already measure what they draw; this is the check that they still do). text120-arc-heart: the old code shows the
#    "VS16" boxes after the sparkles and the heart (and in the bar and on the card); the branch none.
# 3. text120-world-arabic / text120-world-heart: the same two lines in the World layout: the Arabic words the same on
#    both; the "VS16" boxes after the sparkles and the heart only with the old code.
# Run it, and with -f mod_ref=fix/bar119 to compare with the old code (the script comes from --ref):
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/text120 -f version=1.21.11 -f script=.github/checks/text120.txt
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/text120 -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=fix/bar119 -f script=.github/checks/text120.txt

cmd weather clear
cmd time set midnight
cmd gamerule doDaylightCycle false
cmd gamerule advance_time false
set barLyrics true
set hudOnlyOnChange false
set recordCard true
set cardLyrics true
set cardLines 1
set cardCorner BOTTOM_RIGHT
set layout LINES
look 0 -22
sleep 6
fastlines 6000 نمشي معا تحت ضوء القمر الهادئ في الليل الطويل | ✨️ Paper hearts ❤️ glow in the rain | نمشي معا تحت ضوء القمر الهادئ في الليل حتى يعود الصباح إلى المدينة النائمة وتغني الطيور فوق البحر

# 1. Lines
seek 0
sleep 3
where
shot text120-lines-arabic
sleep 6
where
shot text120-lines-heart
sleep 6
where
shot text120-lines-long

# 2. Arc: the words come in as they are sung, so each shot is late in its line
set layout ARC
seek 0
sleep 4.5
where
shot text120-arc-arabic
sleep 6
where
shot text120-arc-heart

# 3. World
set layout WORLD
seek 0
sleep 4.5
where
shot text120-world-arabic
sleep 6
where
shot text120-world-heart

# Back as the test world starts
set recordCard false
set hudOnlyOnChange true
look 0 -28
sleep 2
